page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.3xlarge is a compute-focused instance belonging to the high clock speed ecs.hfc8i family. Driven by a KVM hypervisor, it features 12 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 6462C processor based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is paired with 24.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

The hardware configuration omits local disk storage, requiring deployments to use remote block storage solutions. It includes zero discrete GPUs and provides no complimentary public IPv4 addresses out of the box. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth capacity of 10 Gbps, enabling consistent throughput for intra-datacenter communications.

With its 1:2 compute-to-memory balance and dedicated 3.3 GHz execution cores, the instance provides cost efficiency for CPU-bound tasks where over-allocating system memory would lead to underutilized resources. The primary architectural tradeoff is the complete absence of bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage architectures. Typical workloads include continuous integration pipelines, batch compute processes, gaming backends, web application serving, and compile tasks.
